name: HWR_POST_CON_STATUS
description: Table to save the skill scoring check points.

columns.name: ID
columns.description: This is the primary key for this table.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: The status of last skill scoring, completed or in progress.

columns.name: LOAD_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates if it is incremental or topic ID.

columns.name: LAST_RUN_TIME
columns.description: The last time skill scoring has ran.

columns.name: LAST_STATEMENT_TIME
columns.description: The time stamp of the last loaded statement.

columns.name: LAST_TOPIC_ID
columns.description: The ID of the last loaded skill topic.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
